about.title: About Me
about.text:
Hi! My name is Anna Clara, and I'm a Computer Science student at UNINOVE (2025–2029).

My goal is to continue growing and developing my skills in the technology field. I am particularly interested in Software Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Cybersecurity, where I aim to explore new technologies and improve my skills.

I enjoy turning problems into real-world solutions through programming, and I see every project as an opportunity to learn something new. I am currently working on projects to continuously improve my technical skills and build functional, intuitive, and well-structured applications.

In this portfolio, you will find some of the projects I have developed throughout my journey.Each one represents a challenge overcome, new knowledge gained, and an important step in my growth as a developer.
Feel free to explore my projects and learn more about my work!
